**最终答案 SQL：**

```sql
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ba.ref2 = 2 THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_address_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ba.ref2 = 5 THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_address_count
FROM biz_addr ba
```

逻辑说明：`biz_addr` 是业务实体-地址关联表，`ref1` = 业务实体编号，`ref2` = 地址类型编号。按 `ref2 = 2`（家庭地址）和 `ref2 = 5`（收货地址）分别对 `ref1` 做 `COUNT(DISTINCT)` 去重计数，返回两个独立计数。
